title: Photography backlog
body: Stone Island cargo still unlisted because studio time slipped. Fit is true to size; hem has a faint oil mark on the back-right pocket that should be in the first photo. Do not list until that shot exists.

title: Condition callout
body: Military Black 4s have light inner-sole wear. Call it used, not like-new. Buyers on Grailed punish overgraded midsoles.

title: Grailed seller fee (synthetic)
body: Synthetic policy excerpt: Grailed charges a seller fee on the sale price. Fee changes are versioned on the channel object; do not assume the current fee applied to a past sale.

title: Stale listing playbook
body: If an active listing is older than 14 days with no sale, review price and channel before cutting. High watch rate with zero offers is a price-friction signal, not proof the item is unsellable.
